title: Warm Middle Eastern Cream Cheese Fattoush
description: A sweet and flaky Middle Eastern dish featuring cream cheese and toasted pita bread, perfect for a cozy evening snack

ingredients.name: pita bread
ingredients.notes: toasted and torn into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: mixed greens
ingredients.notes: such as lettuce, parsley, and mint

instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Toss the pita bread pieces with a little bit of olive oil and toast in the oven for 5 minutes, or until crispy.
In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion.
In a separate bowl, mix the softened cream cheese with a fork until smooth.
Add the lemon juice, salt, and pepper to the cream cheese and mix until well combined.
To assemble the fattoush, place the toasted pita bread pieces in the bottom of a serving dish or individual bowls.
Top the pita bread with the mixed greens mixture, followed by a dollop of the cream cheese mixture.
Sprinkle sumac over the top of the dish for garnish.
Drizzle the remaining olive oil over the top of the dish and serve immediately.
